journey.name: Load descriptor
journey.description: Pastes a wallet descriptor in Settings, submits it, verifies the descriptor list updates, then opens the share sheet and copies the loaded descriptor back to the clipboard (issue #113), all without the app crashing.

actions.action: Launch the Mandacaru app and wait for the splash screen to dismiss (poll until nav_node is present)
Expand the Descriptors section if it is collapsed
Read the network (node_network on the Node tab, or input_network in Settings) — the key must match it, since a testnet key is rejected on mainnet

If the network is BITCOIN, type "wpkh([73c5da0a/84h/0h/0h]xpub6CatWdiZiodmUeTDp8LT5or8nmbKNcuyvz7WyksVFkKB4RHwCD3XyuvPEbvqAQY3rAPshWcMLoP2fMFMKHPJ4ZeZXYVUhLv1VMrjPC7PW6V/0/*)" (the BIP84 test-vector wallet, which has mainnet history). Otherwise type "wpkh([73c5da0a/84h/1h/0h]tpubDC8msFGeGuwnKG9Upg7DM2b4DaRqg3CUZa5g8v2SRQ6K4NSkxUgd7HsL2XVWbVm39yBA4LgAFKvDsdsBPzMw3RGYbjeMs9dGcTLeUw6f7c/0/*)"
Verify a "Descriptor loaded successfully" snackbar appears (target by text) and the descriptors list shows the loaded descriptor

Expand the Settings "Node" section and verify its Rescan button reads "Rescanning…" (target by text): loading a descriptor starts a wallet rescan, which waits for the filters while the node is still syncing
Cross-check with the README's cookie-authenticated RPC recipe: listdescriptors contains the descriptor, and getblockchaininfo has rescan_in_progress true and rescan_error null (or absent)
Tap the loaded descriptor row (button_share_descriptor; if more than one row is present, target the first) to open the share sheet
On the share sheet's default "Descriptor" tab, tap the Copy button (target by the "Copy" text; the sheet renders in a separate window so tab/button testTags do not surface)
Verify a "Descriptor copied to clipboard" snackbar appears (target by text) and the app has not crashed
